description: This file is a script for analyzing and verifying web search provider boundary inventory within a codebase. It scans source files, extracts inventory entries related to web search providers, and compares them against expected baselines for integrity checks.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously collects inventory data on web search provider boundaries by scanning relevant source files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory JSON file.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventories for differences.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the full boundary check process, including collection and comparison, with optional CLI arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the boundary check when run as a script.
